o.text:
Etymology tree
Arabic خَزَنَ (ḵazana)der.
Arabic مَخْزَن (maḵzan)der.
Arabic مَخَازِن (maḵāzin)bor.
Venetan magazénbor.
Medieval Greek μαγαζίον (magazíon)bor.
Ottoman Turkish مغازه (mağâza)bor.
Azerbaijani mağaza
Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish مغازه (mağâza), borrowed from Medieval Greek μαγαζίον (magazíon), borrowed from Venetan magazén, borrowed from Arabic مَخَازِن (maḵāzin), from مَخْزَن (maḵzan), from خَزَنَ (ḵazana).
From Russian сигарета (sigareta), from French cigarette, from cigare, from Spanish cigarro + diminutive suffix -ette.
Internationalism; via Russian режиссёр (režissjór), from French régisseur.
From Persian نان کور. Equivalent to nan (“bread”) + kor (“blind”).
From Arabic إِْفْلاج (ʔiflāj), verbal noun of the causative أَفْلَجَ (ʔaflaja) from فَالَج (fālaj), from Aramaic פָּלְגָּא / ܦܴܠܓܳܐ (pālgā), from Ancient Greek πλῆξις, πληγή (plêxis, plēgḗ).
